No.55/1/1/93-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from
18th January, 1993 :-

1) The Prime Minister relinquished the office of the Minister of Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution, Minister of Commerce and Minister of External Affairs.
2) Shri B. Shankaranand relinquished the office of the Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas and assumed the office of the Minister of Health and Family Welfare.
3) Shri Ghulam Nabi Azad relinquished the office of the Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
4) Shri A.K. Antony assumed the office of the Minister of Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Public Distribution.
5) Shri Dinesh Singh assumed the office of the Minister of External Affairs.
6) Shri Vidyacharan Shukla, Minister of Water Resources also assumed the office of the Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
7) Shri Pranab Mukherjee assumed the office of the Minister of Commerce.
8) Shri N.K.P. Salve assumed the office of the Minister of Power.
9) Shri Ajit Kumar Panja relinquished the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and assumed the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Coal.
10) Shri Giridhar Gomango relinquished the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries and assumed the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Planning and Programme Implementation.
11) Shri Kalp Nath Rai relinquished the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Power and assumed the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Food.
